description: Expose n8n tools as an MCP Server endpoint

options.name: n8n User Auth (OAuth2)
options.description: Require user to give consent to use their n8n account

properties.name: requireExecuteAccess
properties.description: Whether the triggering user must also have permission to execute the workflow in the project it belongs to

properties.name: includeUserInOutput
properties.description: Whether to include the calling user's ID, email and name in the trigger output and in the request the connected tools receive

properties.name: path
properties.description: The base path for this MCP server

properties.name: instructions
properties.description: Sent to MCP clients when they connect. Clients that support server instructions typically add them to the model's system prompt — use for guidance that spans multiple tools, such as tool-choice rules or multi-step workflows.
